prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Split Layout Path Selector: Redesign the choose_path screen into a split layout presenting standard adoption and custom photo pet creation side-by-side with visual feature cards. (why: The choose_path step has a long mean duration of 514s indicating user indecision between paths.)
1: [finish, redesign] Desktop Pet Interaction Shortcuts Checklist: Redesign the home_intro screen into a checklist layout displaying core desktop shortcuts and pet control actions. (why: Support received 3 emails about confusion over controlling, hiding, or talking to pets post-onboarding, and finish step conversion is only 64.8%.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Recovery Hint: Display an explicit hint on the sign-in screen reminding users to log in with their original account to sync existing pet data. (why: The top support theme (8 emails) concerns lost or reset pets due to signing in with a secondary account.)
3: [adoption, copy] Adoption Certificate Name Editability Reassurance: Update the adoption certificate copy to inform users that pet names and personality traits can be modified later in settings. (why: The adoption step takes a long time (mean 1017s, median 89s) due to hesitation when choosing pet details.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Overlay Display Guidance Wait Info: Add desktop screen permissions and window overlay troubleshooting tips to the waiting screen while rendering completes. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets failing to appear on desktop upon launch, and waiting screen median duration is 201s.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Story Scroll Layout: Switch story screen layout to story_scroll to present the pet companion narrative smoothly. (why: choose_path target step takes a high mean duration of 514s as users digest introductory content.)
